lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular blobs positioned posterior to the branchial slits, exhibiting increased spatial separation along the posterior-ventral axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs to form a discernible grid-like structure across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges characterized by a high-contrast vertical luminance gradient (light superior edge, shadow inferior edge) running parallel across the upper lateral region.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of discrete circular high-luminance blobs localized within the visible silhouette of the first dorsal fin.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense cluster of significantly smaller, high-frequency luminance spots is visible on the surface of the pectoral fin compared to the larger blobs on the lateral flank.
